title: 19 October follow-up: the blocked career now continues
paragraphs: The original 39-match run remains recorded below. It ended at Season 3, Week 5. It did not beat D1 or the Hero Cup.
After the local fixes, I reopened that same saved career in the muted background browser. Quick Match completed s3-r1-m1 as a 4–2 win over Ulric Rockets.
The career advanced to Season 3, Week 6, with $40,312 and 49 TP. A full reload kept the result. This is one additional real browser match.

The coach cards now include the Level 2 Coaching Office bonus: Nia Thompson's stored Level 2/$600 candidate showed Level 3/$900 head wage and $450 assistant wage. Both roles were occupied, so I did not perform a new browser hire. Focused tests verify the actual head and assistant hire wages.
The rookie creation screen showed $153/week on a separate fresh origin. All seven catalogs use the real wage value.

In a separate UI fixture, the One big night out refusal showed 7 loyalty and 11 morale for the asker, plus 2 loyalty and 3 morale for every other player. Clicking Refuse changed Ken Ash from 65 to 58 loyalty and 64 to 53 morale. This fixture is not career progress.

Grok reviewed the report and fixes. I accepted the confirmed fixes, kept intentional REF display behavior, and deferred academy resale balance changes. Muse and Opus were unavailable because their providers reported usage limits.

Grok caught three checkpoint tool edge cases. The final check covers missing careers, codec failures, engine differences, unavailable matches, and opening-match power removal. His earlier Quick Match energy claim was corrected: only the opponent receives automatic energy changes in a user-controlled Quick Match.

Passed: 206 focused Jest tests across 12 suites; TypeScript; the permanent tool self-check; the captured blocker check; and read-only checkpoint validation with one production-engine simulation. No scoreline goldens, balance changes, new dependencies, commits, pushes, or releases were added.

The permanent tools are scripts/qa/playtest-browser.js and scripts/qa/check-career.cjs. The read-only bridge requires a local ?qa=playtest URL. AGENTS.md points to docs/qa/game-playtest.md. Phone, Tailscale, and Practice Battle instructions belong to the user's other game and were excluded.

Limits: D1 and Hero Cup wins remain unproved. No phone, native, Steam, audible audio, or physical-device performance test was performed. A team with too few legal available players can still be refused; the optional preload now lets the title recover.

rows: Same save completed 4–2, reached S3 W6, and survived reload.
REF display bonus is intentional. No display or balance change.
Shared arrival quote; rendered bonus level/wage; head and assistant hire tests passed.
Shared full-cost copy in card and lapse warning; UI refusal matched asker cost; both difficulty tests passed.
One profitable academy sale does not establish an unlimited money exploit.
Rookie wage comes from the real constant; browser displayed $153.
Tier 5 +18/+10 and lower raw efficiency documented. Training rules unchanged.
Generic scouting text says 2–4 weeks in all seven catalogs. Exact mission slips unchanged.
